## DIRECT framework

The [Digital Research Competencies (DIRECT) Framework](https://directframework.com/) aims to classify and describe a wide range of technical and non-technical skills seen as useful for digital research roles. This is being built with and for the community to develop a shared language when recognising expertise. Resources are also provided within the framework alongside each skill.

In addition to providing a set of shared skill definitions, by signing up you are able to self-evaluate your own skill levels against these definitions and to continue to evaluate this to track your own development.
